narration: पारो घुटनों पर बैठ जाती है। सिर की छाया नीचे उतर जाती है।
caption: Paro drops onto her knees. The shadow of her head slides down.
image_brief: Paro kneeling low on the bed with her arms raised above her, her head below the lamp's light line, the wall ahead brightly washed.

narration: खरगोश लौट आया। बड़ा, मगर फिर भी धुँधला।
caption: The rabbit came back. Big, but still blurred.
image_brief: The wall holding a large soft-edged rabbit shadow whose ears can only just be guessed at.

narration: पारो हथेली से लैंप को घेरती है। रोशनी उँगलियों से छनकर निकलती है।
caption: Paro cups a palm around the lamp. The light leaks out between her fingers.
image_brief: Paro's cupped palm curved around the glowing lamp, bright light slipping through the gaps between her fingers.

narration: एक हाथ लैंप पर लगा, तो कान बनाने के लिए हाथ ही नहीं बचे।
caption: With one hand on the lamp, no hands are left to build the ears.
image_brief: One of Paro's hands resting on the lamp while the other waves alone in the air, an unfinished shape on the wall beyond.

narration: देर तक हाथ ऊपर रखने से उसके हाथ दुखने लगे।
caption: From holding her hands up so long, her arms began to ache.
image_brief: Paro's arms lowered into her lap, the lamp glowing beside her knee, the cream wall in front of her empty.

narration: बड़ा या साफ़, दोनों एक साथ नहीं। यही पहेली है।
caption: Big or sharp, never both at once. That is the puzzle.
image_brief: Paro sitting cross-legged facing the bare wall with her chin propped on a fist, lamp light coming from her side.

narration: उसी पल दूसरे बिस्तर पर छोटी बहन जाग जाती है।
caption: At that moment her little sister wakes up on the other bed.
image_brief: The second low bed across the room, a younger girl with tousled hair sitting up under a thin blanket, dim light on her face.

narration: छोटी बहन उठकर बैठ जाती है। उसे भी खरगोश चाहिए।
caption: The little sister sits up. She wants a rabbit too.
image_brief: The younger sister rubbing one eye and turning toward Paro's lit wall, her own wall dark behind her head.

narration: छोटी बोली, खरगोश मेरी दीवार पर भी चाहिए।
caption: The little one said, I want a rabbit on my wall as well.
image_brief: The younger sister pointing up at the bare wall above her own bed, the lamp's light reaching only halfway across the floor.

narration: अब दो बहनें हैं, दो दीवारें हैं, और लैंप सिर्फ़ एक।
caption: Now there are two sisters, two walls, and only one lamp.
image_brief: Both low beds in one frame with a bare wall behind each, and the single small lamp on the floor between them.

narration: पारो लैंप छोटी की तरफ़ घुमाती है। बारी बारी, यही तय होता है।
caption: Paro turns the lamp toward her sister. Turn by turn, that is the deal.
image_brief: Paro leaning over to swivel the lamp's head toward her sister's side of the room, both girls watching the light move.

narration: पर तार छोटा है। करीब चार कदम, उससे आगे नहीं।
caption: But the wire is short. About four steps, and no further.
image_brief: The lamp's wire pulled straight and taut across the floor to a low socket, with no slack left in it.

narration: लैंप एक ही दीवार तक पहुँचता है। दोनों तक नहीं।
caption: The lamp reaches one wall only. Not both of them.
image_brief: The lamp sitting at the far end of its stretched wire, its glow landing on one wall while the opposite wall stays dark.

narration: छोटी की दीवार पर खरगोश आया। पारो की दीवार अँधेरी हो गई।
caption: A rabbit arrived on the little one's wall. Paro's wall went dark.
image_brief: The sister's wall carrying a rabbit shadow while Paro's wall on the other side of the room lies in darkness.

narration: पारो ने ताली बजाकर कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश! दीवार अँधेरी ही रही।
caption: Paro clapped and said, two claps, one rabbit! Her wall stayed dark.
image_brief: Paro's hands caught mid-clap in the unlit half of the room, her blank wall behind them in shadow.
